slug: 2026-01-07 Why Ethiopia, Somalia and Djibouti are starting to matter in digital Africa

facts.fact: TechCabal says Djibouti, which has landing points for 12 submarine cables including 2Africa, serves as the primary gateway for landlocked Ethiopia, i.e. Ethiopia's international traffic runs via Djibouti; no date given, so the published date is used.

note: Horizon terrestrial corridor is described as being spearheaded, not in service; 2Africa lands in Djibouti, not ETH.
